task.title: Consider an autosync daemon
task.description:
Autosync is now the default action for workbook task updates, but that adds significant network-driven performance hits to most operations, as there are now two separate network calls (fetch and push) for any action.
Having a daemon running in the background continually refreshing the data could significantly alleviate this, as it could be on a separate thread from the CLI and then allow CLI updates to go back to a single local update.
This daemon can be run independently as a new CLI command, or run as part of the web server, so that the web view also stays updated from upstream changes for the user.
